## Privacy

| Model                | Model training | Data retention |
| -------------------- | -------------- | -------------- |
| Alpha Max            | Not used       | 0 days         |
| Theta Pro            | Not used       | 0 days         |
| Zeta Pro             | Not used       | 30 days        |
| Beta Flash           | Not used       | 0 days\*       |
| Beta Pro             | Not used       | 0 days\*       |
| Gamma-Flash          | Not used       | 0 days         |
| Gamma Prime          | Not used       | 0 days         |
| Eta Flash            | Not used       | 30 days        |
| Lambda Contributor   | Yes            | Not ZDR        |
| Omega Preview        | Not used       | 0 days         |
| Deprecated Old Model | Not used       | 30 days        |
| Delta Contributor    | Yes            | Not ZDR        |
| Epsilon Free         | Not used       | 30 days        |
| Kappa Free           | Not used       | 0 days         |

- **Zeta Pro / Eta Flash:** Requests are retained for 30 days under the provider's policy. [Learn more](https://example.invalid/policy).
- **Lambda Contributor:** Discounted token pricing in exchange for permission to use your prompts for training.
- **Delta Contributor:** Free for a limited time in exchange for permission to use your prompts.
- **Kappa Free:** Hosted in a distant region. Requires **Global** regions in your workspace privacy settings.
- **Beta:** ZDR agreement is renewed monthly. The current agreement is valid through November 30, 2026.
